title: Grappl — High-Performance API Modernization & Rapid Feature Delivery
subtitle: Sub-400ms Home Feed Response, Multidimensional Search & CMS Ad Server
summary: RESTful API optimization in Laravel slashing home feed latency to < 400ms, eliminating N+1 queries, introducing faceted search, and deploying a CMS advertising monetization engine.
overview: Grappl is a global community application dedicated to wrestling fans, allowing users to track, rate, and discover historical combat sports matches. In a targeted 2-month engineering engagement working directly with Evoke Mobile executive leadership, the goal was resolving critical load-time bottlenecks on the application home feed, refactoring complex SQL aggregation logic, and launching new product features including multidimensional search and an autonomous CMS advertising platform.
responsibilities: Critical Endpoint Optimization: Reconstructed the Home Feed API, eliminating N+1 query patterns and establishing key relational indexes.
Multidimensional Search Engine: Architected the query filtering engine allowing combined multi-criteria searches (wrestlers, promotions, dates, ratings).
Monetization Module (CMS Ad Server): Built administrative CMS workflows for ad placement, scheduling, impression tracking, and partner campaigns.
Session Management & Security: Hardened session state management for persistent authenticated user navigation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Aggregating community ratings across hundreds of matches per historical event without overloading the relational database.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Refactored raw SQL queries into optimized Query Builder statements with efficient relational prefetching and cached aggregations.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Delivering multiple enterprise features under an aggressive 60-day development window.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Partnered directly with the CEO in daily agile loops and engineered modular service boundaries decoupling ad tracking from content feeds.
